          Interactive 3D Guide
          
How to Shop in 3D

        

        
      


      

      

        

          
🕹️

          
1. Walk & Look Around

          
Use Dual Joysticks on mobile/tablet, or Arrow keys / Custom keys in Settings on PC.

        

        

          
📱

          
2. Tap Any Table or Pick Item

          
Tap any display table in 3D or press Pick Item at the bottom to browse all categories.

        

        

          
🛒

          
3. Cart, Basket & 4 Floors

          
Take a Cart or Basket and ride the escalators or glass elevators across all 4 floors.

        

        

          
🛍️

          
4. Synced Website Bag

          
Every item you add in 3D is saved in your Sizar Phones Bag when you return to the website.
